title: 1973 AHSME Problem 2
statement: One thousand unit cubes are fastened together to form a large cube with edge length \(10\) units; this is painted and then separated into the original cubes. The number of these unit cubes which have at least one face painted is

solutions.text:
The unpainted cubes are precisely the interior \(8\times8\times8\) cube. Therefore the number having at least one painted face is \[ 10^3-8^3=1000-512=488. \]

Therefore, the correct answer is C.
hints: Count the cubes with no painted face instead
Removing the outer layer leaves an \(8\times8\times8\) cube
